title: Flow Launch retains resources after failed stages
description: At immutable Flow revision cadff11, Launch creates a workspace before Furnish and has no Close/delete emission. Furnish refusal or missing beliefs, Create failure, Start failure, and Prompt failure return typed outcomes without cleaning temporary workspace or any pane that may have been created under uncertain transport. Flow Memory stores definitions only, so retained FlowId/workspace/pane has no durable discoverability. Proof-script cleanup is external and does not cover core failure paths.
design: Add a lifecycle design for ownership and rollback/retention semantics before implementation. Preserve typed stage evidence while ensuring resources are discoverable and temporary resources are removed according to approved ownership rules; distinguish uncertain external effects from confirmed failures.
acceptance_criteria: A bounded test or proof exercises each Launch failure boundary and shows the specified pane/workspace ownership, cleanup or durable retention, and restart discoverability. The result states how uncertain Create/Start/Prompt effects are handled.
notes: Addendum at immutable Flow e6cca1: Core.start resets AtomicI64 next_flow_id to 1; Temporary selects State/flow-workspaces/<flow_id>; create_dir_all accepts existing path. Restart can reuse stale flow-workspaces/1 without durable ownership/run record. Concurrent configured Path launches share the exact path (observed, not forbidden). Design prerequisites: persistent run allocation/ownership and exact selected Furnish receipt before external effects, distinct from harness adoption; publication invariants remain pending.

title: Flow Nexus v1 defines and launches one configured Codex flow
description: Implement the fresh version-1 first slice: persist validated Complex definitions in binary Memory, describe and list them after restart, and launch one HarnessDefault Codex member through Belief Furnish and Herdr Create, Start, then Prompt.
design: Core owns binary definition Memory under the selected Place state directory. Define validates and atomically replaces one named Complex. Launch captures the definition, refuses unsupported harness/tools before external effects, then composes typed Furnish, Create, Start, and Prompt calls through the Flow translator. Preserve actual Belief refusals and Herdr outcomes; after Create, failures carry FlowId and Pane. No v0 machinery.
acceptance_criteria: Define survives process restart and Describe/Definitions return the stored definition. Invalid Define preserves the prior value. A configured HarnessDefault Codex member launches through Furnish, Create, Start, and Prompt; missing beliefs and typed stage failures refuse at the correct boundary. The installed CLI is flow-nexus <metaflow> <datom>, and an end-to-end proof distinguishes an assistant response from the submitted prompt. Generated public, Operation, and Emission contracts pass drift checks.
